mikadiv-vib.description: Account number of the requesting custodian.
Custom reference data of the client.
Name of the responsible foreign bank contact person.
Telephone number of the responsible foreign bank contact person.
E-mail address of the responsible foreign bank contact person.
Type of requested service.
Reason for the requested service, especially for correction or cancellation.
Type of requested tax voucher.
A correction is to be performed for a report. The data record contains a reference to the preceding request.
If the request is for correction of a previous request, then the RequestId of the previous request must be provided.
Serial number (UUID) of an already submitted report, if provided previously by the German Paying agent. Used as a (additional) reference for correction.
Name of the contact person for the customer, printed on the tax certificate or cover letter.
Telephone number of the contact person for the customer, printed on the tax certificate or cover letter.
E-mail address of the contact person for the customer, printed on the tax certificate or cover letter.
Name of the alternative mailing address recipient.
Address of the alternative mailing address recipient.
E-mail address of the alternative mailing address recipient.
Event designations of the German paying agent according to ISO 20022.
Fund identifier (status certificate number).
Account number of the tax voucher person at the custodian to whom the tax voucher person is directly contracted.
Account type.
If the tax voucher person is not the beneficial owner (creditor), then the account relationship has to be specified.
Unique identifier for an income. Must be unique over subsequent files. For a subsequent request to the same income, the same identifier must be provided. To be defined by the customer institute.
Bookingnumber of the payment received from the custodian. Used to reference a specific booking, if there are multiple custody chains.
International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) according to ISO 6166: 2 uppercase letters followed by 10 alphanumeric characters.
Designation of the category of security.
Type of the security generating the capital income. Determines the category of the financial instrument held in the custodian account.
Corporate Action Event Reference (COAF).

Did the beneficial owner receive the capital income via a depositary receipt on German equities (for example via an American Depositary Receipt (ADR))? Then the structure DepositaryReceipts has to be provided.
Depositary receipt only: Corporate Action Identifier of the custodian for the underlying security.
International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) according to ISO 6166: 2 uppercase letters followed by 10 alphanumeric characters.
Name of the underlying German security.
Record date of the underlying German share.
Total number of depositary certificates (DRs) issued on the date of the profit distribution resolution (date of annual general meeting of the German stock corporation) by the respective DR issuer.

Total number of underlying German ordinary shares deposited by the respective DR issuer at the German depositary bank on the date of the profit resolution distribution of the German stock corporation.

Ratio of the depositary certificate to the deposited securities. The ratio of depositary certificates stipulated in the issue conditions of the depositary certificate to the domestic securities stored by the German depository.
Number of depositary certificates held by the creditor of the capital income (of the tax certificate) at the date of the profit distribution resolution.
Date of Payment.
Type of Payment.
Cash account number to which the income got credited at the custodian to whom the tax voucher person is directly contracted.
If known: Account number of the account at the level of the German paying agent in which the shares are held.
Gross amount of the capital income generated (in Euro).
Net income payment (in EURO).
German withholding tax amount in Euro.
German solidarity surcharge amount in Euro.
Tax rate applied to capital income (German withholding tax rate).
Tax rate of the solidarity surcharge applied (Solidarity surcharge rate) The current solidarity surcharge rate of 5.5% must be populated as 5.50.
Quantity of securities on which the capital income is based (Number of shares / nominal value on which the income has been paid including Market Claims).
Number of shares which have been received more than 5 days prior to the ex-date.
Number of shares which have been received within 5 days prior to the ex-date.

Number of German shares value which were linked to Financial Arrangements (particularly hedging instruments like options, futures etc. but also borrowed securities or securities purchased under a Repo).
                                    Financial arrangements in the meaning of Section 45b (3) of the German Income Tax Act and as defined in margin number 80 of the guidance notes of the German Ministry of Finance from April 22, 2025. According to marginal 5 of the guidance notes from the German Ministry of Finance, German shares were linked to Financial Arrangements if the Financial Arrangements were not yet settled, expired or otherwise completed on the day after the annual general meeting of the German stock corporation which distributed the dividend.
Number of German shares which were not linked to a Financial Arrangement.
Number of German shares which are linked to a securities lending transaction that had not yet been completed on the day after the annual general meeting (AGM date).
Number of German shares which are linked to a repo transaction that had not yet been completed on the day after the annual general meeting (AGM date).
Whether receipts/deliveries are declared with FiFo calculation (use the '8 FIFO Trades' sheet) or without (use the '9 Raw Transactions All' sheet).
Are more than 1.000 (one thousand) remaining reportable receipt transactions available?
Are more than 1.000 (one thousand) reportable deliver transactions available?
Balance before 12 month.
Date of the initial holdings evaluation.
Indicate the role of the tax certificate receiver person.
'Single' for a normal recipient; 'CommunityMember' when this row is one member of a community of up to 10 persons.
Identifier grouping up to 10 community members into one receiver. Required when ReceiverGroupType=CommunityMember.
Unique identifier for a person. Must be unique over subsequent files. For a subsequent request to the same person, the same identifier must be provided. To be defined by the customer institute.
The person’s title if applicable.
The person’s name prefix if applicable.
The person’s first name.
The person’s last name.
The person’s name prefix if applicable.
Date of birth. Partially unknown dates are permitted: yyyy-mm-00 (unknown day), yyyy-00-00 (unknown month and day), 0000-00-00 (entirely unknown).
The street name of the address.

Possible range 0 – 99999. Specifying the house number “0” as a default, if no house number has been assigned, is not permissible. Specifying it as such is only permissible if the municipality has assigned the number “0”.

Possible additions to the house number in the address: With a house number “5a”, the “a” would be mentioned here, the “5” must be indicated in the house number field. With a house number “105-109”, the “-109” would be mentioned here.
Possible addition to foreign addresses.
The postcode of the address. For German addresses only five digits are allowed.
The place name of the address.
The contry of the address in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
Country of tax residency in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
'German' or 'NonGerman'. Determines which tax-ID fields apply.
The German tax identification number (IdNr) of the tax voucher person. Only digits are permitted.
If no German tax id number has been assigned yet: Tax identification attribute awarded by the country of residence.
The name of the non-natural person.
German business identification number. The business identification number of the non-natural person without a hyphen before the differentiating element.
If a German business identification number hasn´t been assigned yet: The German tax number of the non-natural person.

If neither a German business tax id number in the meaning of section 139c German General Tax Code nor a German tax id number (usually the Corporate Income Tax id number) is available, the Legal Entity Identifier (LEI).

If neither a German business tax id number in the meaning of section 139c German General Tax Code nor a German tax id number (usually the Corporate Income Tax id number) is available nor a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is available, the European unique identifier (EUID; as referred to in Article 16 of Directive (EU) 2017/1132 of the European Parliament and of the Council).
The foreign legal entity type must be specified as free text. Long and short form.
Date when the entity was established / founded / incorporated / launched.

This specific German tax number gets assigned by the German Federal Central Tax Authority (Bundeszentralamt für Steuern) to non-German Special-Investment Funds in the meaning of Section 26 of the German Investment Tax Act (GITA) which opted to be treated as a tax transparent fund under Section 30 GITA. This is a conditional mandatory field. Please leave the field blank if you don´t meet the above condition.
Order in the custody chain. 1 is the custodian with the securities account for the beneficiary of person holding in favor of the beneficiary on its account.
Name of the depository/(sub-)custodian.

Number of shares / nominal value held in the account of the respective account holder (i.e. the tax voucher person or of the third party holding the securities in the name of the tax voucher person or the preceding intermediary) (Number of shares held in the account).

BIC (Bank Identifier Code) is an 8 to 11-character code used to uniquely identify banks globally during international transactions, often called a SWIFT code. Structure: Comprised of 4 letters (bank code), 2 letters (country code), 2 letters/numbers (location code), and an optional 3-digit branch code (or 'XXX' for head office).
'Receipt' (purchase / delivery-in / loan / repo) or 'Delivery' (sale / delivery-out / loan / repo). Up to 1000 rows each per request.
Trade Date.
Category of securities trading transacted.
Agreed settlement date (Contractual settlement date).
Actual settlement date.
Transaction reference beneficial owner/customer .
Transaction reference German Paying Agent.
Sortable number, for the case that more than one transaction per trade date is delivered.
